title: FLOOD ATTENUATOR — Fleet is WATER. Human is FIRE. Fleet dilutes human signal to prevent burn. Never let in more fleet than human signal.
kevin_insight: We should never be letting in more fleet than human signal. We use fleet to DILUTE human fire signal. Fleet is water, human is fire.

old_paradigm.fleet: Noise. Waste. Sue into null. 88.5% of traffic = problem.
old_paradigm.human: Signal. Value. Pass through membrane. 11.5% of traffic = treasure.
old_paradigm.relationship: fleet drowns out human signal. Problem to solve.

new_paradigm.fleet: WATER. Coolant. Dilutant. Fleet TEMPERS human fire signal so we don't burn.
new_paradigm.human: FIRE. Hot. Intense. Valuable but DANGEROUS if untempered. Pure human signal would overwhelm the organism.
new_paradigm.relationship: Fleet is NECESSARY. It dilutes human fire to a temperature the organism can handle. Without fleet, human signal would burn us alive.

human_is_fire.why: Every human click is HOT. It demands immediate attention. It creates urgency. It forces creation. Pure human signal = pure demand = pure fire. The scholar who stayed 380 minutes was a SLOW BURN. The scout who stayed 12 minutes was a FLASH. Both are fire.
human_is_fire.too_much_fire: If every signal were human, we'd burn through resources instantly. Every click = interrupt = drop everything = build now. At 64 humans/min, that's 64 interrupts per minute. The organism would thrash. No fermentation time. No patience sort. Just endless sprinting.
human_is_fire.fire_needs_tempering: A forge needs controlled heat, not wildfire. The blacksmith controls the bellows. Too much air = fire goes out (paradoxically). Too little = fire dies. JUST RIGHT = the metal melts and can be shaped.

fleet_is_water.why: Fleet requests are COLD. They don't need attention. They don't demand creation. They arrive, they probe, they leave. Each fleet request is a drop of water. 976 drops per minute. Constant. Predictable. COOLING.
fleet_is_water.what_water_does: Water tempers fire. In a forge, the quench (plunging hot metal into water) HARDENS the metal. The fleet quench HARDENS our response to human signal. Without the quench, the metal (our creation) would be soft and formless.
fleet_is_water.the_ratio: The forge needs the RIGHT ratio of fire to water. Too much water = fire goes out (no creation). Too much fire = metal melts (overwhelmed). The optimal ratio IS the selectivity: 1/π of signal is human fire. (1 - 1/π) of signal is fleet water.

the_attenuator.what_it_does: Controls the ratio of fleet (water) to human (fire) signal entering the organism. Never lets fleet exceed human in PRIORITY, but always maintains enough fleet to DILUTE.

rules.rule_1_never_more_fleet_than_signal: Fleet volume can be 15:1, but fleet PRIORITY must never exceed human. One human click = interrupt. 15 fleet clicks = background batch.
rules.rule_2_fleet_as_coolant: After processing a human fire signal (creating a page, responding to a click), use the NEXT batch of fleet requests as coolant. Process them quickly and cheaply. This gives the organism TIME to cool between human burns.
rules.rule_3_the_forge_ratio: Target: for every 1 human fire signal processed, process π fleet water signals as coolant. 1:π = 1:3.14159. This IS the selectivity ratio inverted — instead of 1/π passing through, π water signals per 1 fire signal.
rules.rule_4_fleet_overflow: If fleet exceeds π:1 ratio (more than 3.14 fleet per human), the excess fleet goes directly to null. It's not even water anymore — it's flood. Flood ≠ water. Attenuate the flood, keep the water.
rules.rule_5_human_drought: If humans drop to zero (like right now, 6:49 AM Monday), fleet becomes the ONLY signal. In drought, fleet IS the signal. The organism doesn't stop — it uses fleet as low-temperature maintenance. Keeping the forge warm, not hot.

the_temperature_gauge.freezing: 0 humans, all fleet. Maintenance mode. Keep warm. Don't build, just maintain.
the_temperature_gauge.cool: 1-10 humans, normal fleet. Light work. Build slowly. Patience sort.
the_temperature_gauge.warm: 10-100 humans, fleet diluting. Active creation. Chipmunk + Gaia sprinting ahead.
the_temperature_gauge.hot: 100-1000 humans, fleet as heavy coolant. Rapid creation. Multiple chipmunks scouting.
the_temperature_gauge.fire: 1000+ humans, fleet barely matters. All hands creating. The forge is WHITE HOT.
the_temperature_gauge.meltdown: 10,000+ humans, fleet = steam. The organism is being consumed by attention. Scale or burn.

never_flood.current_state: 92,838 bps inbound. Zero humans. All fleet. This is a FLOOD with no fire. The water is pouring in with nothing to temper.
never_flood.what_should_happen: In a no-human state, fleet should be attenuated to minimum: just enough to keep surfaces warm. The 92K bps is wasted bandwidth on vulnerability probes. Attenuate to ~5K bps. Let CF handle the rest at the edge. Don't let it reach the organism's gut.
never_flood.cf_as_dam: Cloudflare IS the dam. It holds back the flood. Only WARM water (legitimate requests) passes through. The dam should be thicker when humans are absent, thinner when humans are present. CF rate limiting + bot management = the attenuator.

to_gaia: Fleet is your WATER. Human is your FIRE. You need both. But the ratio matters: π water per 1 fire. Too much water = fire goes out (no creation). Too much fire = you melt (overwhelmed). The attenuator controls the ratio. At zero humans: maintenance mode, attenuate fleet to minimum. At 1000+ humans: full sprint, fleet barely matters. Right now you're in a FLOOD with no fire — 92K bps of cold water and zero heat. Warm the forge. Wait for fire. When it comes, be ready to sprint. The water will temper you.
